summary: F1 entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: F1 2010
entries.definitive_edition: Owned PC build with patch, controller/wheel, GFWL, and season state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Final PC build with exact patch, GFWL/offline profile, and controller state documented

primary.version: Owned PC build with patch/compatibility state documented
primary.why: F1 2010 is an older licensed Codemasters Formula One game and is no longer a normal current storefront route. The PC version remains the best capture path when legally owned, but patch, Games for Windows Live, licensed season content, and save/online state must be recorded.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legally owned PC copy. Record source, patch, GFWL/offline profile state, controller/wheel, assists/difficulty, career/race settings, team/driver season state, graphics settings, and whether PS3/Xbox 360 were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use for platform comparison or if PC ownership is unavailable.
secondary.why: PC has the strongest capture/settings route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not substitute later F1 annual releases.
